![Image 1: Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

Nov 2, 2023

## [We purchased the Lee Dresser by Sarah…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6543ac99733a8775bedfaf77)
We purchased the Lee Dresser by Sarah Sherman Samuel and received it two days ago. There is a huge quality problem with this item - it is absolutely terrible. The drawers are "push to open" and they barely open!! In order to open some of the drawers I literally have to bang on the dresser, which makes it wobble and shake. Some of the drawers do not close all the way making the piece look broken and cheap. The color is also so much different than pictured - much darker. I could live with this if not for the major quality and functionality problems. 

Upon receiving the dresser I immediately sent a return request to the "customer service" email. I have yet to receive a response. There is no phone number to contact this company and ZERO customer service. This is totally unacceptable for a $3k piece of furniture.

This company is a scam and I will be contacting AmEx to report it as such unless I hear back from someone by the end of this week.

October 31, 2023

Unprompted review

* * *

1

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Nov 3, 2023

Hi Erin, We are sorry to hear about the quality issues with the dresser and for the inconvenience that this has caused you. We have shared your feedback with our supplier as well. Our Customer Experience team assisted you with a return, and we will be issuing a full refund for your order, but please let us know if there’s anything else we can help with in the meantime.
